title: 用行为证据验收
premise: 计划会收尾，确定第一切片的验收与未来发布保护。
listeningTask: 听出验收不只看测试绿灯，还看兼容和回退证据。

lines.en: Our acceptance criteria include identical approved reports. Documented exit codes and arguments stay compatible.
lines.zh: 验收标准包括批准报表一致，已记录退出码和参数兼容。

lines.en: We'll dry-run it first against fixed fixtures. Then compare isolated execution with the old artifact.
lines.zh: 先用固定fixture预演，再把隔离执行与旧制品比较。

lines.en: Keep volatile timestamps normalized in comparison. Don't mask meaningful differences such as row ordering.
lines.zh: 对比中规范易变时间戳，但不能掩盖行顺序等有意义差异。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the vertical slice needs review, right? Passing tests alone won't approve production.
lines.zh: 确认一下，贯通切片需评审，对吧？测试通过不单独授权生产。

lines.en: Yes, I'll sign off consumer output compatibility. Maybe weekly report fixtures need separate acceptance later.
lines.zh: 是，我验收使用方输出兼容，周报fixture以后可能单独验收。

lines.en: The smoke test must include missing configuration. It should fail safely without partial published reports.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试包括配置缺失，应安全失败，不发布半份报表。

lines.en: A mismatch is our future rollback trigger. Stop the new job before restoring old scheduling.
lines.zh: 不一致是将来回退触发，恢复旧调度前先停新作业。

lines.en: Okay, no overlapping writers during any switch. I'll retain the old artifact and configuration.
lines.zh: 好，切换不能重叠写入，保留旧制品和配置。

lines.en: Let's record those gates in the plan. Mid-iteration review will check evidence against them.
lines.zh: 把关卡写入计划，中期检查按它们查看证据。

lines.en: Agreed, the plan is ready to start. We'll reconvene next Wednesday with actual progress.
lines.zh: 同意，计划可开始执行，下周三带实际进度再开会。

scene: 计划会收尾，确定第一切片的验收与未来发布保护。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
